purpose: Diagnose observed losses and test exactly two one-session confirmation hypotheses without relabeling previously used history as independent out-of-sample.

hypotheses.mechanism: Wait one full independent session for observable demand confirmation before committing cash.
Same confirmation on the existing pullback-only opportunity stream; evaluate against Bonly as well as complete.

confirmationRule.clock: Origin signal D close, confirmation only at next independent session D+1 close, earliest attempted fill D+2 open. D and D+1 must both fall in the evaluation period. No retry/backfill.
confirmationRule.price: D+1 has complete positive valid OHLCV/amount; close > open and close >= original signalClose and close > original failurePrice.
confirmationRule.context: D+1 market admission remains true; the original industry remains selected; the stock still belongs to the same industry in the contemporaneously available snapshot.
confirmationRule.ranking: Retain originalRank and original parent opportunity population; never refill rejected ranks.
confirmationRule.metadata: Keep original signalClose, structural floor and meanNtr20 for reservation, opening extension cap and sizing; update decision date/contextCutoff/snapshotId to D+1 and retain origin identity.
confirmationRule.risk: All original complete-policy exits, T+1, suspension/limit gates, cash/lot/sector/gross/risk caps, prior-volume participation proxy and next-open execution retained.

reusedTemporalCheck.label: Previously exposed temporal recheck; NOT pristine out-of-sample

accounts.fees: Exactly parent frozen LegacyFeePolicy and baseConfig; explicitly disclose dated stamp-duty and unadjusted-price source limits.

historicalCandidateScreen: positive net account return in BOTH periods
net return exceeds matched parent in BOTH periods
closed-trade profit factor > 1 in BOTH periods
at least 30 closed trades in EACH period
positive reusedTemporalCheck return under 35bps each-side slippage
decisionRule.benchmark: Report cash 0% and same-date CSI300 price return for context; no claim of dividend-inclusive investable benchmark.
decisionRule.uncertainty: Paired daily-return moving-block bootstrap, fixed block length 20 sessions, 2000 draws, seed 20261031; interval is retrospective and does not correct the entire historical selection process.
decisionRule.noWinner: If neither passes, reject both for promotion; do not select the less-negative variant or change thresholds after results.

oos.status: Not yet available at a sufficient independent length
oos.newSegmentConsumption: Do not consume the two remaining days to advertise a powerless profitability test.
oos.requires: Rules/code/input identity frozen before observing that session; append-only simulated records; no real orders; verify published trading calendar; no parameter reselection from forward outcomes.

limits: Surviving/raw-price source and incomplete historic trade-status/actions remain.
Single-open execution and prior-volume capacity are approximations, not opening-auction fill evidence.
Two candidates add to prior adaptive research; ordinary p-values/Sharpe are not proof of discovery.
executionLock: Pin implementation and test code plus all input references after synthetic checks and before any new account; preserve all results and failures.
